description: Policy-driven publication and lifecycle contract for every supported OneCAD modeling operation/mode. Rows are normative: worker code must match the stated tier, empty/multi-solid semantics, and body lifecycle. Fields marked 'deferred' have an owner dependency recorded in notes.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: 2D sketch entities (point, line, arc, circle, ellipse) on a plane
rows.emptyResultSemantics: no regions emitted; document carries the sketch but no extrudable profile
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: N/A; output is a region set, not a BRep solid
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: N/A
rows.toleranceEvidence: gap repair magnitude recorded; max repairable gap is product policy (deferred: calibrated ceiling)
rows.cancellationPolicy: pairwise intersection loop polls cancellation; over-ceiling sketches refuse with code
rows.previewFidelity: exact kernel regions; analytic curve fragments in V2
rows.persistenceBehavior: sketch entities and attachment round-trip byte-stable; region ids derive deterministically from geometry
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: over-constrained/drag errors are recoverable; the sketch session remains open
rows.notes: Exact fragmented BReps are P2 (regionIdentityVersion:2). Gap-repair ceiling deferred to Phase 2 tolerance policy.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; profile must bound a region
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse; a single NewBody extrude produces exactly one solid
rows.authoritativeHistory: BRepPrimAPI_MakePrism / BRepBuilderAPI_Transform history for Boolean modes
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on the operated body; split children ranked by volume centroid
rows.toleranceEvidence: BRepCheck + positive volume recorded; tolerance ceiling deferred
rows.cancellationPolicy: build is single OCCT call; cancellation via OCCT notifier where wired
rows.persistenceBehavior: profile ref and params round-trip; upstream sketch edits rebind by region id
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: stale region id refuses cleanly; user can re-pick the profile
rows.notes: Covers Blind, ThroughAll, Symmetric, ToNext, ToFace, two-direction. ToFace/ToNext must prove the profile reaches the bounded face.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region + target solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if the profile produces no intersection with target
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: ranked split children replace target deterministically
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target BodyId preserved on modification; ranked children minted on split
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder against the modified target; split children by geometric rank
rows.cancellationPolicy: Boolean build is single OCCT call; cancellation via BOP notifier
rows.persistenceBehavior: targetBodyId and profile ref persist; upstream target edit rebinds target and profile
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: empty/no-overlap result refuses with code; target remains untouched
rows.notes: Boolean-mode extrude uses the same publication policy as standalone Boolean Union.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region + target solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; complete consumption is not a silent delete in v1
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: ranked split children replace target deterministically
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target BodyId preserved on modification; ranked children minted on split
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder against the modified target; split children by geometric rank
rows.cancellationPolicy: Boolean build is single OCCT call; cancellation via BOP notifier
rows.persistenceBehavior: targetBodyId and profile ref persist; upstream target edit rebinds target and profile
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: zero-solid result refuses; full-consumption deletion is a separate product decision
rows.notes: Phase 0 decided: zero-solid Cut is a recoverable refusal, not a deletion.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region + target solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; no ghost body
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: ranked split children replace target deterministically
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target BodyId preserved on modification; ranked children minted on split
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder against the modified target; split children by geometric rank
rows.cancellationPolicy: Boolean build is single OCCT call; cancellation via BOP notifier
rows.persistenceBehavior: targetBodyId and profile ref persist
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: disjoint profile/target refuses with code
rows.notes: Worker/core support exists; UI omits Intersect. Exposing it is a P4 UI decision with cross-track fixtures.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if draftAngle is non-zero but no eligible wall exists
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: N/A
rows.authoritativeHistory: BRepPrimAPI_MakePrism with draft; OCCT draft builder history
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: same as base extrude mode
rows.validationTier: Tier A plus applied-face semantic check
rows.toleranceEvidence: volume/bbox evidence recorded; curved-wall taper check is P0
rows.persistenceBehavior: draft angle persists; upstream edit may refuse if profile becomes unsupported
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: unsupported profile (e.g. all curved walls) refuses with named code
rows.notes: Phase 0 requires applied-or-refused behavior for curved profiles.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region + axis line
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; profile and axis must produce volume
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on operated body; split children by rank if reachable
rows.persistenceBehavior: profile ref, angle, and axis persist; upstream sketch edit rebinds
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: stale axis/profile refuses cleanly
rows.notes: P3 added common shape publication audit.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region + axis line + target solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: ranked split children replace target
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target preserved on modification; children minted on split
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on target; split children by rank
rows.persistenceBehavior: targetBodyId persists
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: no overlap refuses with code

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region + axis line + target solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; complete consumption is not a silent delete
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: ranked split children replace target
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target preserved on modification; children minted on split
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on target; split children by rank
rows.persistenceBehavior: targetBodyId persists
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: zero-solid result refuses

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region + axis line + target solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; no ghost body
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: ranked split children replace target
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target preserved on modification; children minted on split
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on target; split children by rank
rows.persistenceBehavior: targetBodyId persists
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: disjoint result refuses
rows.notes: Core/worker support exists; UI omits Intersect. P4 decision.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: closed sketch profile region + target body edge
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if axis edge missing or curved
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: follows base Revolve mode
rows.authoritativeHistory: typed edge ref resolved through partition/history/ladder
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: typed ref falls back to descriptor scoring on the named body; no ordinal fallback
rows.persistenceBehavior: additive typed axis ref persists; legacy edgeId preserved for replay
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: missing/deleted edge produces NeedsRepair, not OP_FAILED
rows.notes: P1B added additive typed Revolve body-edge axis companion ref.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one target solid + one or more co-body edges
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no edges selected
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse; result must be one solid
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on the same body; mixed-body refs fail before scoring
rows.validationTier: Tier B plus semantic edge diagnostics
rows.toleranceEvidence: max tolerance recorded; ceiling is diagnostic until calibrated
rows.cancellationPolicy: build is single OCCT call; cancellation wired via OCCT notifier
rows.persistenceBehavior: typed edge refs persist; upstream edit rebinds by identity/descriptor
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: over-large radius and missing edges report structured diagnostics
rows.notes: P1A enforces co-body edge ownership before the ladder runs.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one target solid + one or more co-body edges
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no edges selected
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse; result must be one solid
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on the same body; mixed-body refs fail before scoring
rows.persistenceBehavior: typed edge refs persist; equal-leg and two-distance modes round-trip
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: short/curved edges and missing edges report diagnostics
rows.notes: P3 routes Chamfer through the same Tier B validator as Fillet.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one target solid + one or more co-body face refs
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no faces selected
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse; result must be one connected solid
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on the same body; foreign-body refs fail before scoring
rows.persistenceBehavior: typed face refs persist alongside legacy bare ids; upstream edit rebinds
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: cross-body selection refused before arming; invalid result refuses
rows.notes: Positive thickness only; multi-face and inward/outward policy deferred to P4.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: two solids (target and tool)
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; disjoint union still produces one solid from target+tool
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse if fuse produces disjoint pieces; otherwise modifies target with tool consumed
rows.bodyLifecycle: target modified; tool deleted on success
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target BodyId preserved; tool BodyId removed
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: split result ranked by volume centroid; ordinal tripwire detects permutation
rows.cancellationPolicy: BOP polls cancellation; tool consumed only after successful classification
rows.persistenceBehavior: target/tool BodyIds persist; upstream edits rebind by body id
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: disjoint/touching cases handled per policy; split ranking is deterministic
rows.notes: Tool deletion happens only after successful result classification.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: two solids (target and tool)
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; complete consumption is not a silent delete in v1
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: ranked split children replace target; tool consumed on success
rows.bodyLifecycle: target modified or split; tool deleted on success
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target preserved on modification; ranked children minted on split; tool removed
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: split result ranked by volume centroid; ordinal tripwire
rows.cancellationPolicy: BOP polls cancellation; tool consumed only after successful classification
rows.persistenceBehavior: target/tool BodyIds persist
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: zero-solid result refuses with code; target and tool remain
rows.notes: Phase 0 decision: zero-solid Cut is a recoverable refusal.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: two solids (target and tool)
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse; no ghost body
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: ranked split children replace target; tool consumed on success
rows.bodyLifecycle: target modified or split; tool deleted on success
rows.bodyIdPolicy: target preserved on modification; ranked children minted on split; tool removed
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: split result ranked by volume centroid; ordinal tripwire
rows.cancellationPolicy: BOP polls cancellation; tool consumed only after successful classification
rows.persistenceBehavior: target/tool BodyIds persist
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: disjoint result refuses with code
rows.notes: P4 standalone Intersect coverage landed: C++ fixtures (overlap/containment/identity/touching), Rust real-worker preview/commit/save-reopen/undo tests, and Playwright chip-to-feature-label flow.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one source solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if count or spacing produces no instance
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: legacy V1 publishes one source-inclusive result body under the source BodyId
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: source body modified as a whole; no per-instance children
rows.cancellationPolicy: count and cumulative fuse ceiling; loop polls cancellation
rows.persistenceBehavior: legacy records without resultPolicyVersion replay V1
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: invalid spacing/count refuses with code
rows.notes: V1 retained for legacy replay.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one source solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if count or spacing produces no instance
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: require exactly one connected solid; PATTERN_DISJOINT_RESULT on disconnected fuse
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: source body modified as a whole; no split children
rows.cancellationPolicy: count and cumulative fuse ceiling; loop polls cancellation
rows.persistenceBehavior: resultPolicyVersion:2 persists; count edits remove tail children only
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: disconnected fuse refuses PATTERN_DISJOINT_RESULT
rows.notes: P3 implemented V2 fused policy.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one source solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if count produces no transformed instance
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: source remains unchanged as instance 0; count N creates exactly N-1 deterministic children body_<opId>:<k>
rows.bodyIdPolicy: source BodyId preserved; children minted as body_<opId>:<k>
rows.authoritativeHistory: instance transforms applied per copy; no fuse history
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: children are new bodies with no history dependency on source topology
rows.persistenceBehavior: resultPolicyVersion:2 persists; children stable across count edits and reopen
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: count reduction removes tail children; suppression removes children only
rows.notes: P3 V2 source-preserving lineage.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one source solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if angle/count produces no instance
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: legacy V1 publishes one source-inclusive result body under the source BodyId
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: source body modified as a whole; no per-instance children
rows.cancellationPolicy: count and cumulative fuse ceiling; loop polls cancellation
rows.previewFidelity: exact kernel BRep; partial sweep uses angle/count (P0 parity)
rows.persistenceBehavior: legacy records without resultPolicyVersion replay V1
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: invalid angle/count refuses with code
rows.notes: V1 retained for legacy replay.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one source solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if angle/count produces no instance
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: require exactly one connected solid; PATTERN_DISJOINT_RESULT on disconnected fuse
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: source body modified as a whole; no split children
rows.cancellationPolicy: count and cumulative fuse ceiling; loop polls cancellation
rows.previewFidelity: exact kernel BRep; partial sweep uses angle/count (P0 parity)
rows.persistenceBehavior: resultPolicyVersion:2 persists
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: disconnected fuse refuses PATTERN_DISJOINT_RESULT
rows.notes: P3 implemented V2 fused policy.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one source solid
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if count produces no transformed instance
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: source remains unchanged as instance 0; count N creates exactly N-1 deterministic children body_<opId>:<k>
rows.bodyIdPolicy: source BodyId preserved; children minted as body_<opId>:<k>
rows.authoritativeHistory: instance transforms applied per copy; no fuse history
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: children are new bodies with no history dependency on source topology
rows.previewFidelity: exact kernel BRep per instance; partial sweep uses angle/count (P0 parity)
rows.persistenceBehavior: resultPolicyVersion:2 persists; children stable across count edits and reopen
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: count reduction removes tail children; suppression removes children only
rows.notes: P3 V2 source-preserving lineage.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one source solid + mirror plane
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if plane is invalid
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: result is one mirrored solid under a new BodyId
rows.bodyIdPolicy: source preserved; new BodyId deterministically minted
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: copy is a new body with transform history only
rows.persistenceBehavior: source BodyId and plane params persist
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: non-planar/infinite plane refuses with code
rows.notes: UI hard-codes no-fuse today; this is the supported v1 mode.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one source solid + mirror plane
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if plane is invalid
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: require one connected solid; disjoint result refuses
rows.bodyLifecycle: source modified in place with fused result
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: source body modified as a whole
rows.persistenceBehavior: fuse mode stored on record; reopen preserves mode
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: disjoint fused result refuses with named code
rows.notes: fuseWithOriginal exists in core/worker but UI hard-codes false. Exposing it is a UI decision.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one or more target solids
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no targets or zero vector
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: each target remains one solid; multi-target modifies all atomically
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: anchors move with the body; descriptor ladder on moved geometry gated
rows.validationTier: Tier A per result (P3 deferred full Tier B for performance)
rows.persistenceBehavior: translate/rotate params persist; copy flag false
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: malformed vectors refuse; all-or-nothing on multi-target failure
rows.notes: P3 Transform policy row; Tier A enforced via publication_decision in worker/src/ops/TransformOp.cpp. Full Tier B is performance-deferred.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one or more target solids
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no targets
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: each target copied as one solid; deterministic child BodyIds
rows.bodyIdPolicy: sources preserved; copies minted as body_<opId>:<k> in target-list order
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: copies are new bodies
rows.validationTier: Tier A per result (P3 deferred full Tier B for performance)
rows.persistenceBehavior: translate/rotate params and copy flag persist
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: malformed vectors refuse; all-or-nothing on multi-target failure
rows.notes: P3 Transform policy row; Tier A enforced via publication_decision in worker/src/ops/TransformOp.cpp. Full Tier B is performance-deferred.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: STEP/BREP/XBF container; one or more solids
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no extractable shape
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: each extracted solid becomes a first-class body; invalid solids are advisory by policy
rows.bodyIdPolicy: bodies minted deterministically from import record ordinal
rows.authoritativeHistory: XCAF/BinXCAF provenance; no OCCT builder history
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: imported bodies are new; downstream ops use descriptor ladder
rows.validationTier: Tier A evidence plus explicit import invalid-solid warning policy
rows.toleranceEvidence: BRepCheck recorded per solid; tolerance ceiling diagnostic
rows.cancellationPolicy: BREP/XBF read/scale cancellation where practical; STEP parse cancellation deferred
rows.persistenceBehavior: content-addressed import blob + provenance; xbf-primary replay
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: invalid file reports structured diagnostics without crashing
rows.notes: Import invalid-solid handling remains an explicit policy exception, not a silent failure.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one target solid + host face + point on face
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if host face missing or point off face
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: legacy V1: disconnected host remains one multi-solid body (documented residual); new-record refusal is deferred
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on target body; stale promotion refused
rows.toleranceEvidence: BRepCheck + volume recorded; analytic volume fixtures
rows.persistenceBehavior: typed host face and point persist; legacy bare id fallback
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: cross-body host ref refused; stale promotion leaves pick mode
rows.resultPolicyVersion: V1 legacy multi-solid residual accepted; new-record policy deferred
rows.notes: P1A enforces host face body equals target body. P3 leaves legacy one-body multi-solid residual versioned.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one target solid + one or more co-body face refs
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no faces selected
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse; result must be one connected solid
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on same body; foreign-body refs fail before scoring
rows.toleranceEvidence: BRepCheck + volume + self-interference + movement check recorded
rows.cancellationPolicy: single OCCT offset call; prepare response fenced by snapshot
rows.persistenceBehavior: typed face refs persist; prepare closure fenced by revision/snapshot
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: stale prepare response refused; invalid closure re-picks
rows.notes: P1A ownership + P1B snapshot fence implemented.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one target solid + one or more co-body face refs
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no faces selected
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse; result must be one connected solid
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on same body
rows.persistenceBehavior: mode and params persist
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: stale prepare response refused
rows.notes: C++ implementation strong; Rust execution and browser commit/re-edit tests are P4.

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one target solid + one or more co-body face refs
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no faces selected
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse; result must be one connected solid
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on same body
rows.toleranceEvidence: BRepCheck + volume + self-interference + movement check recorded
rows.persistenceBehavior: mode and params persist
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: invalid radius refuses

rows.inputTopLevelShapes: one target solid + one or more co-body face refs
rows.emptyResultSemantics: refuse if no faces selected
rows.multiSolidResultSemantics: refuse; result must be one connected solid
rows.historyAbsenceBehavior: descriptor ladder on same body
rows.persistenceBehavior: mode and params persist
rows.userRecoveryBehavior: invalid diameter refuses
rows.notes: C++ implementation strong; Rust execution and browser commit/re-edit tests are P4.
